_note: Single source of truth for every outbound partner link. `url` is the plain official site (the fallback, always kept). When a program approves us, paste the tracked link the network issues into `affiliateUrl` (that is the ONLY field to change); the site then uses it automatically, marks the link as an affiliate link, and the disclosure page updates. Leave `affiliateUrl` empty until approved. Never invent tracking IDs. All partner links render with rel="sponsored nofollow noopener".
